blocks.text: How to Avoid Car Rental Scams?
Car rental is a great option that makes your travels easier. However, unfortunately, this sector has also become the target of fraudsters. To avoid fraud when renting a car, consider these tips:
1. Choose Reliable Companies

Before renting a car online, check the company's history and customer reviews. Choosing well-known and well-established companies reduces the risk of fraud. You should prefer companies affiliated with ITO, such as Zakcar.
2. Check the Reliability of the Website

Make sure the website's URL starts with “https://”. Additionally, sites that include details such as contact information and physical address are generally more reliable. For example, https://zakcar.com/. Prefer sites protected with 256 Bit Security.
3. Be Wary of Suspiciously Low Prices

Car rental offers well below market prices are often a sign of fraud. Offers that are too tempting to be true are usually unreliable. Just as every service has a price, rental car service also has a maximum price. On average in Türkiye, the most affordable base package vehicles start at prices around 1,200,000 TL. The daily rental fee of a vehicle in this price range cannot be 500 TL. You can consider 1/1000 of the vehicle price as approximately one day's rental fee.
4. Review the Agreement Carefully

Read the contract in detail before renting a car. Make sure there are no hidden fees or shady ingredients. If there is something you do not understand, ask for clarification. Read traffic insurance, car insurance details and coverage thoroughly.
5. Pay Attention to Payment Method

Only use reliable payment methods. Stay away from companies that request advance payment or money transfer. Choose traceable payment methods such as credit card. If you are going to pay in cash, do not pay without seeing the vehicle and checking the license and contract information. You can choose online payment systems that use 3D security codes on their websites.
6. Get a Copy of Your Documents During Vehicle Delivery and Pick-Up Process

When picking up and dropping off the vehicle, take photos or videos documenting the situation. This will protect you against possible damage claims.

A user who wants to rent a car is required to have a Class B driver's license valid for at least 1 year. Also, in general, the minimum age is 21. These standard conditions apply to all economy segment vehicles.

In higher segments, the age and driving license requirement increases. For example, individuals who want to rent premium or luxury vehicles are generally expected to be 27 years old and have a driver's license for a minimum of 3 years. These criteria are very important for security.
Credit Card and Credit Score Requirement

Car rental companies only accept personal credit cards in order to manage the security deposit and payment flow processes. Cash, debit cards or virtual cards are absolutely not valid. Additionally, in order for the reservation to be finalized, the credit card limit must be sufficient to cover the rental fee and deposit.

Apart from a credit card, a certain credit score is also required for car rental. It is necessary to have a credit score above the medium risk group. Especially for luxury vehicles, this score is required to be 1500 and above. This allows the company to minimize financial risk.
Segment Based Car Rental Conditions
Economical Car Rental Conditions

Vehicles in the economic segment generally have the most flexible category in terms of rental conditions. In order to rent such vehicles, it is sufficient to have a driver's license for at least 1 year and be 21 years old. In addition, young drivers between the ages of 19-21 can use these vehicles by paying an extra fee.

Economical vehicles are especially popular among students and individual users with their fuel efficiency and low daily rental price. If you are a new driver's license holder, this segment may be an ideal starting point for you.
Comfort and Middle Class Car Rental Conditions

The conditions for vehicles in the middle segment of the comfort class are slightly stricter. To rent a vehicle from this segment, you must be at least 23 years old and have a driver's license for 2 years. Individuals between the ages of 21-23 can access these vehicles by paying the Young Driver Fee.

The comfort segment consists of vehicles that offer performance and comfort together. In this class, which is frequently preferred especially for business trips and family holidays, safety measures and driving experience are very important.
Age and Driving License Requirement for Luxury and Premium Vehicles

Age and driving license requirements are stricter for luxury vehicles and premium segment rentals. For the luxury group, a minimum age of 27 and a driver's license of 3 years is required. Although the same conditions apply for renting premium segment vehicles, limited access can be granted to drivers aged 25 and 3 years with the Young Driver Application.
This segment is generally preferred for special occasions, protocol services or long journeys. Lease terms generally require a higher credit score and more collateral.
Young Driver Application
Who is Considered a Young Driver?

The definition of young driver is determined by age range and driver's license duration. Generally, people between the ages of 19-21 are considered as economical vehicles, users between the ages of 21-23 are considered as comfort segment vehicles, and drivers between the ages of 23-25 ​​are considered young drivers for the prestige segment. This application does not apply to drivers outside these age ranges.
Young Driver Fee and Application Conditions

Young drivers must pay an additional fee to access certain vehicle segments. This fee is added to the rental price on a daily basis and is a security deposit against driving risks. Each company determines this price according to its own pricing policy.

Those who will benefit from the young driver application are also expected to present their ID, valid driver's license, appropriate credit score and personal credit card. The rental process cannot be started without these documents.
Additional Terms of Service
Additional Drivers and Usage Restrictions

If the vehicle is intended to be used by someone other than the renter, the additional driver service option should be preferred. The additional driver must also meet the car rental conditions (such as age and driver's license period). Additionally, the additional driver must be added to the rental agreement and have his signature.

If a person not included in the rental agreement has an accident while driving the vehicle, all insurances will be deemed invalid. In this case, both the renter and the user become legally and materially responsible.
Vehicle Pick-Up and Delivery Rules

The full tank principle applies when delivering the rental car. The vehicle is given to the customer in this way and it is expected to be returned in the same way. In cases of returns with missing fuel, a service fee is charged in addition to the fuel fee.

If the vehicle delivery time is delayed, an option period of up to 59 minutes is given. If this is exceeded, an additional day fee will be charged. If the delivery is intercity, a one-way fee may also be charged.
Payment and Deposit Terms
Prepaid Reservation Rules

If the "Pay Now" option was used during the online reservation, the customer must pay the total rental fee and the selected additional service fees immediately. This payment can only be made by personal credit card. The reservation holder must be present in person during the rental and present his/her credit card.
If the reservation is canceled up to 24 hours in advance, the full fee will be refunded.
If canceled with less than 24 hours remaining, the deduction in question will apply:
For reservations between 1-3 days, 1 day fee will be deducted.
A 2-day interruption is applied between 4-7 days.
For reservations of 8 days or more, a 20% deduction will be made.

The deposit amount varies depending on the vehicle segment and this amount must be within the appropriate limit on the credit card. At the end of the rental period, the deposit will be refunded within 3-5 business days for cases that are not used or do not require extra service.

blocks.text: Car rental is a service that provides great convenience in travels and daily life. However, it is very important to know your insurance options to ensure your safety and avoid unexpected costs when driving a rental car. Car rental insurance offers a variety of policies covering possible accidents, theft and third party damages. Understanding the insurance types correctly makes your rental process safer by allowing you to choose the one that best suits your needs. In this article, we will discuss in detail the types of insurance offered for car rental.
Automobile Insurance (CDW – Collision Damage Waiver)

One of the most common types of insurance offered for rental vehicles is Collision Damage Waiver (CDW). This insurance covers the repair costs within a certain limit if the rental vehicle is damaged as a result of an accident. However, CDW insurance generally does not provide full coverage. While damage to the exterior of the vehicle, costs resulting from collisions and mechanical damages are covered by CDW, situations such as tire, glass and headlight damage, damage resulting from misuse and unauthorized use of the vehicle may not be covered by insurance.

If the protection offered by CDW insurance is not sufficient, SCDW (Super Collision Damage Waiver) i.e. Extended Motor Insurance can be preferred. SCDW provides broader assurance by covering parts such as tires, glass and headlights. Thus, your car rental process becomes safer and you are protected from unexpected costs.
Theft Insurance (TP – Theft Protection)

One of the most important types of insurance to consider when renting a car is Theft Insurance (TP). It provides financial security in case the vehicle you rent is stolen or attempted to be stolen. While the total theft of the vehicle or damage caused while trying to steal it is covered by insurance, situations such as loss of vehicle keys or theft of the vehicle due to negligence may not be covered by insurance.

Theft insurance provides more comprehensive coverage when taken together with CDW insurance. However, it is important to review the insurance policy in detail to check which situations are covered. In particular, additional coverage may be considered, taking into account the security situation of the region you are traveling to.
Third Party Liability Insurance (TPL – Third Party Liability)

One of the most critical car rental insurance policies is Third Party Liability Insurance (TPL). TPL covers the costs that will occur if you damage another vehicle, pedestrian or property with the vehicle you rented. This insurance, which covers damages to third parties in accidents, provides protection against material damage and bodily injuries and minimizes legal liabilities.

However, although TPL insurance is often included in the rental price, it is important to check the policy's limits and coverage in advance. Especially if you are renting a car abroad, it is recommended that you examine the insurance limits in detail and consider additional insurance options.
Personal Accident Insurance (PAI – Personal Accident Insurance)

When renting a car, Personal Accident Insurance (PAI) offers important assurance for the driver and passengers. It includes medical expenses and compensation payments in cases of injury, disability or death that may occur as a result of an accident. This insurance can provide additional assurance, especially for those traveling abroad. It offers coverage such as post-accident hospital expenses, medical intervention expenses, and compensation in case of loss of life or permanent disability.

However, since many travel health insurers already offer similar coverage, you can evaluate whether you need PAI insurance by checking your existing policies. If your current health insurance offers adequate coverage, you may not need to purchase an additional PAI policy.
Fully Comprehensive Insurance Packages

Some rental companies offer Full Coverage Insurance Packages for customers who want to minimize all risks. These packages often combine CDW, TP, TPL and PAI insurance to provide the highest level of protection. Fully comprehensive insurance packages ensure the protection of parts such as tires, glass and headlights, providing a completely safe driving experience during the rental period and preventing unexpected costs.

This insurance package generally costs more, but can be advantageous in the long run as it offers comprehensive protection. If you are a frequent traveler or your car rental period is long, you can provide extra security by considering fully comprehensive insurance packages.
Which Insurance Type is Right for You?

Car rental insurance protects you from unexpected costs during your trip and provides a safer driving experience. If you're a short-term rental, basic CDW and TPL insurance may be sufficient. However, if you are renting for a long time or driving in a higher risk area, it is important to consider additional insurance.

By reading your insurance policy carefully and choosing the option that best suits your needs, you can both protect your budget and make your car rental process safer. With Zakcar, you can choose the best option for you by examining insurance coverage in detail.

blocks.text: Car rental is a practical and comfortable solution, especially for travels, business trips or daily use. However, there are some important points to consider during the rental process. Wrong choices and carelessness can lead to unexpected costs and negative experiences. In this article, we will explain step by step the basic elements you need to consider when buying a rental car.
Choose a Reliable Car Rental Company

One of the most important steps in the car rental process is to work with a reliable company. There are many companies in the market with different pricing and service quality. To choose the right company, you can get an idea about the reliability of the company by reviewing customer comments. Reviews on Google, Trustpilot and social media platforms can help you understand the firm's past customer experiences.

Additionally, it is important to make sure that the company is licensed and operating legally. You can verify the reliability of the company providing car rental services by checking their authorization documents. Comparing prices and choosing the option that best suits your budget will also provide an economic advantage. Additionally, checking whether customer service is available will allow you to be prepared for possible problems that may arise during the rental process.
Consider Vehicle Insurance Options

Correctly evaluating insurance options when renting a car allows you to take precautions against possible accidents and financial losses. Most car rental companies offer different types of insurance. Collision Damage Waiver Insurance (CDW) covers vehicle damages up to a certain limit in possible accidents. Theft Insurance (TP) protects you from financial losses in case the vehicle is stolen.

While Third Party Insurance (TPL) covers damages to the other party's vehicle or property in accidents, Fully Comprehensive Insurance provides broader coverage, including parts such as glass, tires and headlights. You should examine the insurance coverage in detail and choose the one that suits your needs. Choosing the right type of insurance against unexpected situations will make your rental process safer.
Check Vehicle Status

Carefully inspecting the vehicle before taking delivery helps prevent possible problems you may encounter during the rental process. It is important to check the vehicle body, bumpers, windows or interior trim for any scratches, dents or tears. Such damages may cause you additional costs at the end of the rental period.

It is also necessary to test the mechanical and electrical parts of the vehicle. Checking whether the headlights, signals, brakes, air conditioning and other electronic systems are in working order ensures a safe driving experience during your journey. The condition of the tires is also an important criterion; Worn tires can compromise safety. You can avoid any disputes that may arise during the return process by noting the fuel level and mileage when you receive the vehicle.
Learn Fuel and Mileage Policies

Fuel and mileage policies of car rental companies may vary. You should familiarize yourself with these policies in advance to avoid possible additional costs. Most companies apply the "full delivery - fully loaded return" policy. In this case, when returning the vehicle, the fuel level must be at the level you received it from. Otherwise, the company may charge high fuel fees.

In addition, some companies may impose daily or total mileage limits. If you exceed the stated limit, you may have to pay extra mileage charges. Therefore, carefully reviewing the company's mileage policies before renting will help you avoid unexpected costs.
Read the Rental Agreement Carefully

The car rental contract is an important document that contains all the details of the rental process. You should learn about the rental period and late fees before signing the contract. Knowing how late fees are calculated when the car rental period expires will help you avoid possible surprise costs.

It is also very important to learn about deposit and return conditions. Some companies may request a certain amount of deposit against possible damages. Learning about insurance terms and deductibles will help you understand how to act in any unexpected situation you may encounter. Checking the costs of additional services such as navigation, child seat or adding an extra driver also helps you manage your costs.
Pay Attention to the Vehicle Delivery Process

In order to have a smooth experience during the vehicle delivery and return process, it is necessary to pay attention to some important points. Determining the delivery and return points in advance with the car rental company ensures that the process goes faster. Adhering to the vehicle return time will help you avoid additional late fees.

Additionally, it is important to inspect the vehicle for damage before returning it and document any damage that may have occurred during the rental process. This step prevents you from being unfairly charged when returning the vehicle. Finally, checking the fuel level of the vehicle and ensuring that it is at the level specified in the contract when you deliver it will help you avoid extra fuel charges.
Benefit from Additional Services and Campaigns

Car rental companies offer special campaigns and additional services from time to time. It is important to evaluate these opportunities for a more economical and advantageous rental experience. You can rent a car at more affordable prices on special occasions or by booking early. You can save a lot of money by following the campaign periods.

Additionally, if you constantly rent a car from the same company, you can benefit from discounts by participating in loyalty programs. Some companies may offer free additional services in exchange for a certain level of customer loyalty. For example, you can benefit from benefits such as a navigation device, child seat or additional driver service free of charge. Taking advantage of such opportunities can make your car rental process more economical.
Suggestions for a Hassle-free Car Rental Experience

When buying a rental car, it is of great importance to choose a reliable company, carefully examine the insurance and contract details, check the physical condition of the vehicle and comply with fuel & mileage policies. Planning the vehicle delivery and return processes well will help you avoid extra costs. Additionally, you can have a car rental experience that suits your budget by following the campaigns and benefiting from additional services.
By paying attention to these suggestions, you can both protect your budget and have a smooth car rental process.

Types of Damage That May Encounter in Rental Vehicles

Remove the bolts completely and carefully remove the damaged tire. Place the spare tire in place and secure it by tightening the bolts by hand. Then, tighten the bolts in a diagonal pattern so the tire fits properly.
6. Lower the Vehicle and Tighten the Bolts

In the position where your vehicle is raised with a jack, after installing the tire completely, lower the jack and place the vehicle on the ground. In the last step, tighten the bolts firmly. Make sure the tire is seated securely.

blocks.text: How to Choose the Most Suitable Car Rental Option for Your Trip?

If you need a vehicle to travel, explore new places or make business trips, we, as Zakcar, bring you the right choice. Renting a car offers great freedom for your trip. However, with so many different vehicle types and rental options, choosing the right one can sometimes be confusing. Here are some important tips to determine how to choose the right car rental option and the factors that will make your trip more enjoyable!
1. Determine the Purpose of Your Trip

It is very important to clarify the purpose of your trip before making your car rental decision. Every trip requires a different type of vehicle. For example, if you are going on a family vacation, SUVs or minivans with their large interior volume and high comfort will be ideal. If you are going on a business trip, more compact and economical vehicles may be more suitable. If you want to explore or go on nature tours, powerful options such as 4x4 off-road vehicles can be preferred.
Family Vacation: SUV, minivan or large sedan vehicles
Business Travel: Economic class vehicles, compact vehicles
Adventure and Exploration: 4x4 vehicles, off-road vehicles

At this point, Zakcar offers you the most suitable vehicle for every possibility with its wide range of vehicles. No matter which type of vehicle you choose, we promise you a comfortable and safe driving experience.
2. Pay Attention to the Vehicle's Fuel Efficiency

If you plan to travel long distances, fuel efficiency is a very important factor. Choosing a vehicle that provides low fuel consumption helps you save both your budget and the environment. For this reason, it will be useful to examine how much fuel the vehicle consumes per kilometer and choose economical vehicles. In addition, vehicles that consume less fuel for urban journeys will make it easier for you to cope with traffic.
As Zakcar, you can take a look at our vehicles that offer economical fuel consumption and make an environmentally friendly choice while saving money on your trip.
3. Choose Vehicle Size Wisely

The amount of luggage you need to carry on your trip and how many people you will be traveling with are factors to consider when choosing vehicle size. If you have a large family or a lot of luggage, choosing a large vehicle provides comfort. Additionally, if parking spaces in the city are narrow, smaller vehicles can be parked more easily.
Families and Excess Luggage: Large vehicles, SUVs or minivans
Urban Travel: Compact vehicles
Zakcar offers vehicles that can easily carry your luggage and have a comfortable journey throughout your trip, with vehicle options suitable for every situation.
4. Review Vehicle Insurance

Insurance is very important when renting a car. Most car rental companies offer additional insurance options in addition to basic insurance packages. These insurances cover you in case the vehicle is damaged or stolen. Also, if you are traveling abroad, you should definitely check the insurance coverage.

Some credit cards also offer insurance support for car rental transactions. Therefore, finding out if your credit card provides car rental insurance can help you avoid paying additional insurance fees.
As Zakcar, you can examine various insurance packages for our vehicles and choose the one that suits you best. We offer service by considering every detail to keep you safe throughout the journey.
5. Determine the Car Rental Duration Correctly

Car rental period is an important factor that directly affects the price. While short-term rentals can often be more expensive, long-term rentals offer more economical options. If your trip will be long, you can save money with long-term rental options.
Zakcar offers advantageous opportunities for long-term car rentals with campaigns and discounts. Determining the correct car rental period according to your needs will help you manage your budget.
6. Check Vehicle Delivery and Return Conditions

Paying attention to delivery and return conditions when renting a car will ensure your trip goes smoothly. Before taking delivery of the vehicle, check the current condition of the vehicle. If there are any scratches, damage or missing items, report them to the rental company. Likewise, avoid extra charges by checking the fuel level and vehicle condition when returning the vehicle.
Zakcar offers user-friendly conditions in vehicle delivery and return processes. You can easily pick up your vehicle and return it in the same way.
7. Don't Ignore Your Future Plans

If you are planning more than one route during your journey, you should choose your vehicle accordingly. Vehicles with comfortable features, especially for long journeys, can make your trip more enjoyable. Extra features such as navigation, cruise control, USB ports and Bluetooth provide you with great convenience on long journeys.
Zakcar offers well-equipped vehicles to make every moment of your journey convenient and comfortable.
In Conclusion

Finding the right car rental option is very important for your trip to be comfortable and stress-free. As Zakcar, we are at your service with economical and safe vehicle options suitable for the purpose of your trip. We provide service with vehicles suitable for all occasions, from family holidays to business trips, from nature exploration to city tours.
Remember, a well-planned trip is the key to a perfect holiday. Plan your trip safely with Zakcar, enjoy the journey!
